claims: Fátima is located in Portugal.
The 1917 Marian apparitions were witnessed by three shepherd children Lúcia Santos, Francisco Marto, and Jacinta Marto.
Francisco Marto and Jacinta Marto were cousins of Lúcia Santos.

The three secrets focused on prayer.
The three secrets focused on a vision of hell.
